name: tietu-toutiao
description: An AI-assisted newspaper cover editor with schema-validated content state (v1/v2), multi-page synthesized covers with selected items, deterministic PNG rendering, and a self-review gate.

displayDescription.en: Turns one or many newspaper pages into mobile cover concepts, synthesizes selected items into one cover, and renders deterministic, versioned, review-gated PNGs.
displayDescription.zh: 把单版或多版报纸转成手机头图：条目化综合选题、结构化编辑决策、自审门禁、四模板确定性渲染与版本回退。

defaultInitPrompt.zh: 上传这张报纸版面，生成 3 个贴图头条方案
defaultInitPrompt.en: Upload this newspaper page and create three Tietu Toutiao cover concepts.

quickPrompts.en: Upload this newspaper page and create three Tietu Toutiao cover concepts.
quickPrompts.zh: 上传这张报纸版面，生成 3 个贴图头条方案

quickPrompts.en: Synthesize this batch of newspaper pages into one cover with selected items.
quickPrompts.zh: 把这批报纸综合成一份带条目清单的头图

quickPrompts.en: Revise the previous version: tell me what you are not happy with.
quickPrompts.zh: 修改上一版：说哪里不满意就行
